name: glass
title: Glass
description: Liquid Glass for every device: real iOS 26 Liquid Glass (interactive, mergeable with GlassGroup), system material blur on older iOS, real blur on Android 12+ inside GlassProvider / GlassBackdrop (a frosted surface otherwise) and backdrop blur on web — with a specular rim, hairline edge and soft shadow wherever the glass is emulated. The base every glass component is built on.
